source_authority: Newer maintained API declarations win incompatible contracts; original distribution APIs are explicitly legacy. No source implementation has been copied.
notes: Compiler-backed example callbacks depend on the explicit legacy/Compiler/module.jai schemas and genuine Basic memory/output services.
Latest BuildCpp and Bindings_Generator source contains trivial return stubs. These bodies were rejected; callable build/generation functions remain absent.
Newer Program_Print.print_expression requires a genuine current Compiler AST printing provider; it is absent.
is_coff intentionally recognizes AMD64 only, is_macho 64-bit little-endian only, and is_elf requires a 64-byte header, matching the legacy probe domain.
The macOS 10 minor-to-Darwin conversion is minor+4, consistent with the legacy comment examples 10.13=>17; the legacy implementation subtraction was inconsistent.
Plist writers escape XML text and reject unsupported Any types before writing a key. No bundle creation, icon conversion, or file copy occurs.

Simple_Package.check_header validates offset lower bounds and uses subtraction to avoid overflow; a 64-byte header plus a 64-byte empty table of contents is accepted. Package parsing and writing remain absent.
Inventories exclude tests, examples and native binary artifacts. Private declarations are included with scope labels for maintainers.
